reviews.text:
If you're looking for quality, service, and pampering (lots of cuddles) for your pet, this is definitely the place.

At Vetalia, everything is done with love and dedication; I could see that firsthand, and so could my pet, who left very happy. The best in the neighborhood.
The stylist doesn't do the haircuts properly and left my dog ​​Galleta with a mop of hair.
Groomers are super rude and awful.

Good evening! Today I took my dog ​​to the groomer and was greeted by David, who performed the bath with zero kindness and was very rude. The service was subpar and I was not satisfied, and the treatment was even worse. Please address this issue with your staff.
They are super attentive to both owners and dogs, mine love going there 💘

It's a real nightmare trying to get medical attention. Yesterday I came in, and they told me they couldn't see me because all the doctors were conveniently on their lunch break. They all conveniently eat lunch between 2 and 3 pm.

I had another appointment today, and they told me the doctor doesn't have time to see me because it's 10:30 am, and he has another appointment at 11.

In other words, in 30 minutes, he doesn't have time to examine the four teeth I want my dog ​​to have extracted.

It's a nightmare; it's always "how can we not see you, how can we solve your problem?"

If you're looking for personalized care from a vet who really understands your pet, then this isn't the place. Every time I have visited this clinic, my pet is treated by a different vet who doesn't know my pet and doesn't seem to have taken the time to review her medical history saved in their system. Sometimes the vets are good, sometimes the vets are very unaware of my pet's conditions, sometimes the vets are completely incorrect, sometimes I'm better off consulting chatgpt. The care is inconsistent, they will over prescribe meds, and over recommend tests. Additionally, if you don't get in direct contact with whichever vet who has most recently treated or run tests on your pet, then don't expect followup. I would only go here for vaccines, very specific treatment, and specific surgeries/procedures.

Excellent service, all the doctors are top-notch, and they offer immediate and scheduled care! They share your pet's file at any branch, which gives you peace of mind knowing your furry friend will receive excellent care! Congratulations!

Terrible service in Condesa. I've been trying for three days to get an invoice that I urgently need, and at reception they just keep saying, "This is as far as I can go, I can't help you any further." I don't know who can help. Where is customer service? Nobody can help me.
Excellent service, the reception staff answered my questions and were very friendly.
I love the reception staff. Fun fact: I loved the bathrooms.

Their organization and logistics are terrible.
They confuse dogs and numbers, and they don't give you the reports you need.
They have connections with other branches, but there's no clear communication between them.

I really didn't like the service. They told me my dog ​​was fine, but they still prescribed medication. Plus, the woman at the front desk was eating chips instead of taking my payment when I finished.

We called to ask if they could do an EMERGENCY ultrasound and they said yes. We know it's difficult because of the time, but they said they could take the case.

We arrived and explained that it was an emergency and that my dog ​​was vomiting blood. They told us it would take approximately 40 minutes to be seen once we arrived. My dog ​​vomited blood again while we waited, which ended up being an hour and a half.

Seeing that they weren't going to see us, we started calling other hospitals until we found one that would see us as a true emergency. We had to go upstairs to ask if they were going to see us or not, otherwise we would go somewhere else because our dog was vomiting blood and we had already been waiting for an hour and a half. There was no one at reception and we were literally locked in, unable to leave.

They told us it would still take a while, so we decided to leave.

It's unacceptable that they told us they would take the case, then they kept us waiting for an hour and a half, knowing it was an emergency. They should have told us from the beginning that if it was urgent and they didn't have availability, it was better to go somewhere else.

The person who attended to us was completely indifferent to the situation and showed no empathy whatsoever. The doctor never even came out to see her, not even briefly, despite knowing it was an emergency and that she was vomiting blood. At no point did anyone even approach the dog, ask any further questions, or show any interest in the animal.

I would absolutely not recommend a "hospital" like this that didn't care at all about a patient, the urgency of the situation, or being honest about it. Save yourself the time, frustration, and terrible service.

I took my dog ​​there and they left her with all sorts of injuries. They try to charge you for everything after agreeing on a price and then refuse service. They go against the advice of external veterinarians because they think they're better, and they're extremely rude on the phone and even worse in person—truly appalling.
They are all very nice, and they take very good care of the patients.

I'd never taken my dogs there before and I loved the service! I walked in without an appointment and they were treated wonderfully!! And the prices were great! I definitely recommend this place 🤩🤩🤩🤩 …

Terrible experience. We arrived for an emergency at 11 pm, rang the doorbell several times, and no one answered. They made us wait outside for 15 minutes.
Finally, when we got inside, our dog started vomiting, and instead of attending to her (as it was an emergency!), they kept us waiting for 30 minutes, making us repeat our medical history and re-enter our information because they couldn't find our dog in the system.

Definitely, if you have an emergency, this is NOT the place.
